description_en: Queries the status of the CC protection feature for the specified domain names
description_zh: 查询指定域名的cc防护功能开关状态
name: DescribeDomainCcProtectSwitch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management. If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: ddos高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组id。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain names of the websites. You can specify up to five domain names.

A website forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。最多可查询5个网站业务域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domains
